items.title: A blanket impl over the tuple family (`impl type T: (2..: Show) with Show`) satisfies a `T: Show` bound for a NON-tuple struct at the bound check, and emission then dies with "internal: a call resolved to `Show`'s requirement `show`, which has no body"
